bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

events.title: Glo Quiz — The Lenches Club
events.body: Gather a team, bring your favourite tipple and compete for prizes at a live, hosted quiz night from 8pm.

events.title: Veg Fest 2026 — Evesham
events.body: Evesham's biggest celebration of fruit and veg, with plant-based chefs The Happy Pear among the guests — a family day of food, demos and stalls from 10am.

events.title: A Celebration of Noel Coward — Bretforton
events.body: Evesham's own Alistair McGowan and his wife Charlotte perform a personal selection of Noel Coward's songs and rarely-heard poems at Bretforton Theatrebarn, from 7pm.

events.title: A Flavour of the Fleece — Bretforton
events.body: Fleece Inn landlord Nigel Smith leads an evening tour of the historic Bretforton pub and its centuries of collected artefacts, with tastings along the way, from 6.15pm.

events.title: Paint and Pud: Summer of Love — Bishampton
events.body: A relaxed evening of guided painting and indulgent desserts on a 'Summer of Love' theme at The Vale Golf Club, Bishampton, from 6.30pm.

events.title: Broadway Arts Festival Exhibition — Broadway
events.body: The festival's annual open art competition and exhibition runs from 25 September to 4 October, showing work by professional and amateur artists across every medium.

events.title: Jay & Eli live music — The Lenches Club
events.body: The Jay & Eli duo bring an evening of live acoustic rock and pop to the Club from 8.30pm.

events.title: Evesham Rambling Club Sunday walk — Evesham
events.body: A friendly 10-mile Sunday ramble through the villages and along the River Avon, pausing for a picnic lunch; from 10am.

events.title: Fleecey Folk: Miguel Girão — Bretforton
events.body: Glasgow-based Portuguese musician Miguel Girão brings his exploration of folk traditions to the Fleece Inn, Bretforton, from 8pm.

events.title: Pershore Broad Street Market — Pershore
events.body: Around 30 stalls of farm-fresh produce, food and crafts — everything grown or made within 10 miles of the town — fill Broad Street from 9am to 2pm.

events.title: Harvest Lunch — Church Lench Village Hall
events.body: Church Lench Village Hall hosts a two-course Harvest Lunch with a licensed bar and raffle, 12.15 for a 12.30 sit-down; £15 per person. Tickets from Lyndall (871925), Celia (870147) or Nadine (woakesn@hotmail.com).

events.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang — Evesham
events.body: Phoenix Theatre Group stage the family musical based on Ian Fleming's story at The Henrician, Evesham, with evening performances from 7 to 10 October.

events.title: Apple & Ale — Bretforton
events.body: The Fleece Inn's annual cider-making weekend and real ale festival returns to the Bretforton orchard, with music, morris and merry-making from Friday 9 October.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Sunday services continue across the ARCH benefice churches at Harvington, Rous Lench, Abbots Morton, Church Lench and Norton & Lenchwick. Further afield, Flora Fields' pick-your-own dahlias run at Webbs, Wychbold until the end of September.

news.title: School applications open for September 2027
news.body: Applications for primary and secondary school places starting in September 2027 opened on 1 September 2026 — worth noting the date if you have a child due to start or move up.

news.title: Wychavon challenges Government over planning powers
news.body: Wychavon District Council has taken the Government to the High Court over changes affecting local planning powers — a case with potential implications for how decisions are made across the district.

news.title: Range Rover stolen from Fladbury
news.body: A Range Rover was reported stolen from nearby Fladbury this week — a reminder for rural residents to stay vigilant and keep vehicles, keys and outbuildings secure.

news.title: Cricket club: new players welcome
news.body: With the season just ended, the club is already looking ahead — players of all ages and abilities are wanted, whether experienced, returning or brand new. Contact Venky on 07442 772470 or Charlie on 07775 660065.

notices.title: Road closures at Church Lench
notices.body: Atch Lench Road and Low Road, Church Lench, are set to close from 21 September until 16 October for National Grid works, with diversions in place — allow extra time when travelling locally.

notices.title: Severn Trent update — South Lenches
notices.body: South Lenches Parish Council reports the persistent Evesham Road and Hipton Hill leaks are down to the old water main, which Severn Trent must decommission before the flow can stop; an update on timing was expected this week. Further planned works follow at Hill Furze Road, Sheriffs Lench (13–26 October) and Handgate Lane (27 October–29 November).

notices.title: Autumn tennis lessons for all ages
notices.body: The Tennis Club, with new partner Encompass Coaching, is running tennis lessons for children and adults this autumn — a good chance to brush up your game or start a new one.

notices.title: Newsletter deadline
notices.body: Got something for next week? Send it to website@thelenches.org.uk by the end of Wednesday.
